blocks.text: County Line Glen Valley Homes for Sale | Langley Acreages

parts.t: County Line Glen Valley offers a unique blend of scenic farmland, private acreages, and peaceful rural living in one of Langley’s most sought-after countryside communities. Known for its wide open spaces, quiet roads, and beautiful mountain and valley views, this area is ideal for buyers looking for privacy, room to grow, and a true country lifestyle while still being within driving distance to city amenities.

Explore spacious estate parcels, hobby farms, and distinctive country properties that provide opportunities for agriculture, equestrian use, or simply enjoying a more relaxed pace of life. Many homes in County Line Glen Valley feature large lots, detached shops, and long private driveways, making them perfect for those who value space, nature, and independence.

Despite its rural feel, the area offers convenient access to Langley, Abbotsford, and major commuter routes, allowing residents to enjoy the best of both worlds — quiet acreage living with nearby shopping, schools, and services just a short drive away.

blocks.text: County Line & Glen Valley: Langley's Rural Beauty

parts.t: County Line and Glen Valley represent Langley Township's most scenic rural areas, offering acreages, equestrian properties, and authentic country living with stunning mountain backdrops. These neighbouring communities attract buyers seeking larger parcels for horses, hobby farming, or simply the space and natural beauty that multi-acre properties provide. Residents appreciate the pastoral settings with pastures, mature trees, and agricultural character while remaining within reasonable distance of Langley's urban amenities.
